license.note: First-party Simverse reference runtime. No third-party runtime code is redistributed; the model provider is the project's configured Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

model_provider.credential_config: settings.llm_api_key (operator-supplied secret, never in the sandbox)

operations.isolation: runs as a standalone HTTP process; holds no DB/Redis/world handle
operations.egress: only the configured model endpoint; tool effects are Broker-mediated
operations.cancel: cooperative; the Gateway supervision layer fences on top
